properties.displayName: QC - D - gsecdump artifact dropped on disk
properties.description:
The query identifies suspicious binaries that perform the WriteToLsassProcessMemory action type on the target system.
This behaviour has been seen when credential dumping tools are used. A "High" Integrity Level is required to dump
credentials successfully. Advanced adversaries may change the name of the binary or modify the source code to perform
credential dumping attacks.
References:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/
- https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0008/
- https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/threats/malware-encyclopedia-description?Name=HackTool:Win32/Gsecdump
properties.query:
let TimeFrame = 1h;
let GsecDumpIoCSearch = 
(union isfuzzy=true
(DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has_any ("OpenProcessApiCall", "CreateRemoteThreadApiCall", "ReadProcessMemoryApiCall", "NtAllocateVirtualMemoryRemoteApiCall")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex "(^[0-9-a-z]{8})-([0-9a-z]{4})-([0-9a-z]{4})-([0-9a-z]{4})-([0-9a-z]{12}).exe"
| join (
  DeviceEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
  | where ActionType has "WriteToLsassProcessMemory"
  | where (AccountDomain == "" and isempty(AccountName) 
      and isempty(FileName) and isempty(FolderPath) 
      and isempty(ProcessCommandLine) and isempty(ProcessId) 
      and isempty(ProcessTokenElevation))) on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessParentId
  | extend ActionTypes = strcat(ActionType, " , ", ActionType1)
  | summarize InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), InitiatingProcessFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName), InitiatingProcessFolderPath = make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath),
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), ProcessCommandLine = make_set(ProcessCommandLine), 
              InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId),InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), ProcessId = make_set(ProcessId), 
              count() by DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, 
                          AccountDomain, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
                          ProcessTokenElevation, ActionTypes
  | project-reorder DeviceName, ActionTypes, FileName, FolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId, ProcessId, 
                  AccountDomain, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,  ProcessTokenElevation 
),
(DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has "FileCreated"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "-a"
| where FileName matches regex "^(g64-([0-9a-z]{3}).exe)$"
| summarize InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), FileName = make_set(FileName), FolderPath = make_set(FolderPath),
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), 
          InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), 
          count() by DeviceName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,  InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
| project-reorder DeviceName, ActionType, 
                  InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, FileName, FolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId, 
                  InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
),(DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has "ImageLoaded"
| where FileName matches regex "^(g64-([0-9a-z]{3}).exe)$"
| summarize InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), 
              InitiatingProcessFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName), FileName = make_set(FileName), FolderPath = make_set(FolderPath),
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath = make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath), InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), 
              InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), 
              count() by DeviceName,  InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
| project-reorder DeviceName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, 
                  InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, FolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId,
                  InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel 
),(DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has"WriteToLsassProcessMemory"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex "^(g64-([0-9a-z]{3}).exe)$"
| extend additionalFields=parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| summarize InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), InitiatingProcessFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName), InitiatingProcessFolderPath = make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath),
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), ProcessCommandLine = make_set(ProcessCommandLine), 
              InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId),InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), ProcessId = make_set(ProcessId), 
              count() by DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, 
                          AccountDomain, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
                          ProcessTokenElevation, ActionType
  | project-reorder DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId, ProcessId, 
                  AccountDomain, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,  ProcessTokenElevation 
),(DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has "FileCreated"
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName has_any ("powershell","cmd")
| where FileName matches regex "^g64-([a-z0-9]{3}).exe$"
| where FileSize > 0
| summarize InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), FileName = make_set(FileName), FolderPath = make_set(FolderPath),
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), 
          InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), 
          count() by DeviceName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,  InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
| project-reorder DeviceName, ActionType, 
                  InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, FileName, FolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId, 
                  InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
)); GsecDumpIoCSearch
